Little Krishna once cried to his mother, because of a girl. And that's how Holi got its colors. As the story goes, Krishna looked at his blue skin in the river, then at Radha, so fair, so bright.
He ran to Yashoda in tears. Mother, why am I so dark, and Radha so fair? She'll never play with me. Yashoda laughed, and whispered a secret.
Wait, what did she tell him? Go and color her face. Any color you like. So Krishna grabbed a fistful of red powder, ran to Radha, and painted her cheeks.

She laughed and colored him back. Soon the whole village was red, yellow, green and pink. That's why we play Holi with colors. Love sees no color. Comment Holi, and tag the first person you would color.
